And If you want me to add specific recipes for certain automation categories, make a comment.
Recipes included from - Create: Automate Everything
- 250 mb of lava can be compacted into a magma block
- Magma blocks can be frozen into basalt
- Basalt can be crushed to get 1 blackstone and a 20% chance for a lapis lazuli (Lapis can now be automated)
- 1 cobblestone, 1 cinder flour, and 25mb of lava can be compressed into 1 netherrack (netherrack + cinder flour can now be automated)
- 4 gold nuggets, and 1 limestone can be mixed into 1 ochrum
- 1 cinder flour and 1 cobblestone can be mixed into 1 crimsite (better redstone automation)
- 1 crimsite and 1 quartz can be mixed into 1 veridium (copper can now be automated)
- 1 ochrum, 1 veridium, and 1 redstone can be mixed into 2 asurine (zinc can now be automated)
- 1 magma block can be milled into 2.5 magma cream (magma cream can now be automated)
- 1 clay block can be compressed into 1 dripstone block (better dripstone automation)
- 1 dripstone block can be cut into 2 dripstone spikes
- 1 cobblestone, 1 cobbled deepslate, 1 andesite, 1 diorite, and 1 granite can be mixed to make 16 tuff (another way to automate brass)
- 4 cobblestone can be compressed into 1 cobbled deepslate
